name: Cobblestone
desc: A granite sett pavement laid in nested fan courses running away to the vanishing point — every stone is an individual dome whose crown flares as a raking light pool drifts over it and whose sand joint takes the light straight back, with two cart ruts polished down the middle where a century of wheels went and the whole pavement streaming toward you; dry granite, rain-slick at night, an albumen sepia plate, moss deep in every joint, or a cyan setting-out plan.

energy.doc: how hard the light pools rake the stone — crown flare, sheen in the ruts, and the scroll rate

scale.doc: sett size in world units — at min a fine mosaic of small stones, at max colossal blocks

density.doc: how much dust and low drift blows across the stone

speed.doc: how fast the pavement streams toward the viewer

wear.doc: a century of traffic — joint width, how deep the cart ruts are polished in, moss in the gaps

x.doc: vanishing point x as a canvas fraction

y.doc: horizon y as a canvas fraction — everything above it stays fully transparent so the bg shows through

style.doc: aesthetic: dry grey granite under a raking light / rain-slick at night, water standing in every hollow and the light pools smeared across it / an albumen sepia plate of an old quarter / long abandoned, moss risen out of every joint / a cyan setting-out plan — the fan geometry as pure line, no modelling at all

seed.doc: stone lottery — per-sett tone, grain and the wander of the courses
